Officer's narrative
Officers were dispatched to a low-speed head-on collision in Baytown, Texas. Driver 1 and Driver 2 were operating
their vehicles when the front ends made contact. Driver 1 was seated in the vehicle when officers arrived and was
seen there by the responding officer, and Passenger, who was in the front seat, confirmed that Driver 1 had been
driving. Driver 1 reported neck strain and said the force of the impact pushed them forward and back against the seat.
Based on the direction and force of the collision, that account is consistent with the damage to both vehicles, which is
largely in line with the reported impact. Scene photgoraphs show several of the damaged areas described by the
drivers. No independent witnesses were located. Driver 2 reported no prior damage to their vehicle, and nothing at
the scene suggested earlier damage to Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 is listed as a named driver on the insurance policy
for the vehicle involved.
</page>
